title: viola curtisiae
intro: Viola curtisiae, commonly known as  Japanese pimpernel or yellow pimpernel, is a species of flowering plant in the family Violaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Viola curtisiae include acting as an antioxidant, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory agent, which may help to soothe skin irritations and promote tissue repair. The bioactive constituents of Viola curtisiae include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
